content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-live-4|payment]] platforms like Stripe are not accessible, digital creators face significant barriers to setting up online stores. This guide empowers you to build a fully functional crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-18|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-16|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]] Pages, bypassing traditional payment systems. With the right infrastructure, you can establish a sovereign digital commerce presence that operates independently and securely, allowing you to focus on your creations without limitations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure model is designed for resilience. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, your store benefits from robust hosting that scales seamlessly. The combination of Workers and Supabase ensures that your backend logic and data storage are both powerful and flexible. You bypass the conventional barriers imposed by traditional payment processors, allowing you to accept crypto payments effortlessly. This architecture empowers you with ownership and control, essential for navigating the challenges of financial isolation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store, gather your digital products and prepare your assets, such as images and descriptions. Create accounts on Cloudflare and Supabase, and set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with GitHub or Cloudflare’s documentation regarding deployment practices. You’ll also need the Sovereign Blueprint, which guides you through the configuration process and troubleshooting steps. Having everything organized beforehand streamlines your deployment and minimizes potential delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments integration for seamless transaction processing. Set up your Cloudflare Workers to handle payment verifications and order confirmations efficiently. Supabase serves as your database, storing customer orders and managing product data. Ensure that your delivery pipeline, which leverages Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, is ready to deliver files automatically upon successful payment. This integrated approach guarantees that your customers receive their products instantly, enhancing their purchasing experience.
Own your infrastructure—no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it’s time to go live. Deploy your site via Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all configurations are activated. Conduct a test transaction using a small amount of crypto to verify that payments are processed correctly and that product delivery is functioning as intended. Monitor the transaction flow to confirm that everything operates smoothly. This initial testing phase is crucial for identifying any issues before promoting your store to a wider audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store gains traction, consider expanding your product offerings. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, allows you to add more products while maintaining high performance. Implement advanced features such as email notifications and customer analytics to enhance user engagement. Regularly assess your infrastructure to ensure it can handle increased traffic and transactions. With the right scaling strategy, your crypto store can grow sustainably while delivering exceptional service to your customers.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by utilizing frameworks like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and tools such as Supabase for database management. This setup eliminates the need for traditional payment processors, enabling you to launch your store without upfront costs.
Deploy your crypto store in less than 48 hours with Stack 02.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I start building my crypto store?

Begin by gathering your digital products and creating the necessary accounts on Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for detailed deployment instructions to ensure a seamless setup.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with additional features and end-to-end testing.
Can I host my store on GitHub Pages?
Yes, you can host your digital store on GitHub Pages using Stack 01. It provides a free hosting solution, but consider Stack 02 for enhanced performance and quicker deployment.
How do I ensure my payment processing is secure?
Integrate NOWPayments for secure crypto transactions. Set up Cloudflare Workers to handle payment verifications and ensure your site is configured with HTTPS for added security.
What support is available after deployment?
After your deployment, you receive a 30-day support window for troubleshooting and guidance. This ensures your store runs smoothly as you begin processing transactions.
